module_outcomes: Ukwenza izibalo ezilula ezihlanganisa imithetho ye-electrical
Ukuthola ulwazi oluphelele ngezisekelo zamasekhethi kagesi.
Ukusebenzisa ngendlela efanele amathiyoremu ezinhlelokusebenza zikagesi ekuhlaziyweni kwamasekhethi.
Ukuhlaziya ama-transient kanye nama-steady state response kumasekhethi kagesi.
Ukukhombisa ukuqonda ithiyori ye-steady-state AC kanye nokuhlaziya amasekhethi e-AC kusetshenziswa izinombolo ezinkimbinkimbi kanye nemidwebo yama-phasor.
Ukuchaza amakhonsepthi e-real power, imaginary power (ukugcineka kwamandla kagesi) kanye ne-complex power.
Ukusebenzisa izinto zokusebenza ezibalulekile elabhorethri kanye nokuhlola ukusebenza ngendlela kwezinto ezisetshenziswayo ezimeni zangoqobo.
module_purpose: Le mojuli ihlose ukukhuthaza kanye nokungenisa abafundi olwazini lomklamo we-electrical engineering. Le mojuli ijwayeza abafundi amasekhethi kagesi kanye namathiyoremu ezinhlelokusebenza, amakhonsepthi e-DC response, steady-state AC response, transient response kanye nokuhlaziywa kwe-single-phase AC kusetshenziswa imidwebo yama-phasor. Okunye futhi, inikezela ngolwazi lokwakheka kwamandla kagesi, ukusatshalaliswa kwawo, kanye nesimo samandla kumasekhethi ayi-single phase.
